description: Pay $0.005 USDC via x402 to call /v1/crypto-news. Crypto news API with AI sentiment scores: crypto headlines only. Without payment, returns payment requirements.

coin.description: Optional ticker such as BTC, ETH, NVDA or EURUSD, matched against the AI-tagged coins and the tickers named in each record.

limit.description: Maximum records to return, 1 to 100. Default 50.

since.description: Optional UTC time such as 2026-11-13T09:00:00Z: only records first seen after it, so a bot polling every hour pays for new items only.

tag.description: Optional label to match, lower case: a ticker (btc, nvda, eurusd, xau), a topic or an event type (token_listing, etf_approval).

name: pay_cryptoNewsSentimentApi
